title: Parallel Reader
user: An intermediate language learner with legitimately obtained EPUBs in two languages who needs synchronized reading, audio, and private word capture.
smallest_useful_product: An offline web reader for two DRM-free EPUBs with chapter alignment, manual paragraph anchors, side-by-side mode, and TSV export of selected sentence pairs.
constraints: Accept only DRM-free files; no included copyrighted text; keep books and selections in IndexedDB/local export; make alignment manual and reversible.
